newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Triquint started as buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Triquint started as buy.

text.p: --Rauscher Pierce Refsnes Inc on Friday said it initiated coverage of Trinquint Semiconductor Inc with a buy-market outperformer rating on its stock.
--Triquint is one of two primary manufacturers of gallium arsenide, used in high-frequency applications in the wireless communications industry, the firm said.
--Rauscher Pierce's 12-month price target on the stock is $31. Its earnings estimates are $1.07 a share for 1997 and $1.60 for 1998.
